title: Generative Translation Priors: Bayesian Imaging with Cross-Modality Image Translation
abstract: arXiv:2608.28872v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ability to leverage images from co-available modalities to inform target-domain reconstruction is highly desirable in imaging algorithms. In this work, we introduce Generative Translation Priors (GTP)--a Bayesian framework that transforms diffusion-based image-to-image translation models into cross-modality image priors for ill-posed imaging inverse problems. GTP incorporates target-domain measurements through likelihood guidance, steering the translation process toward the desired posterior distribution. The framework is grounded in a theoretical analysis of the resulting posterior dynamics, which reveals an intrinsic bias introduced by likelihood guidance. We further characterize this bias and derive a ground-truth-free formulation for its estimation, enabling it to serve as a practical metric for assessing posterior sampling quality. translated_title: 生成式翻译先验：基于跨模态图像翻译的贝叶斯成像
translated_abstract: 在成像算法中，利用共同可得的模态图像来指导目标域重建的能力是非常理想的。在这项工作中，我们提出了生成式翻译先验（GTP）——一个贝叶斯框架，它将基于扩散的图像到图像翻译模型转化为针对病态成像逆问题的跨模态图像先验。GTP通过似然引导纳入目标域测量，引导翻译过程朝向所需的后验分布。该框架建立在对所得后验动力学的理论分析基础上，揭示了似然引导所引入的内在偏差。我们进一步刻画了这种偏差，并推导出一种无需真值的估计公式，使其能够作为评估后验采样质量的实用指标。基于这一分析，我们推导出两种基于梯度和近端算子的离散化GTP算法。
tldr: 提出了生成式翻译先验（GTP）贝叶斯框架，将扩散图像翻译模型转化为跨模态图像先验以解决病态成像逆问题，并从理论上揭示似然引导引入的内在偏差，给出无需真值的偏差估计方法作为后验采样质量评估指标。
en_tdlr: We introduce Generative Translation Priors (GTP), a Bayesian framework that transforms diffusion-based image-to-image translation models into cross-modality image priors for ill-posed imaging inverse problems, with theoretical characterization of the intrinsic bias from likelihood guidance and a ground-truth-free formulation for estimating it as a practical metric for posterior sampling quality.
